急速射击的伤害提高25%。

急速射击的每发子弹使瞄准射击的冷却时间缩短0.50秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Rapid Fire damage increased by 25%.

Each shot fired from Rapid Fire reduces the cooldown of Aimed Shot by 0.50 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 急速射击现在获得弹无虚发效果。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Rapid Fire grants Precise Shots.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 爆炸射击的持续时间延长1.0秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Explosive Shot lasts 1.0 sec longer.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 向目标射出一发爆炸射击，持续3秒。每1秒目标会因燃烧而受到([307% of Attack Power])点火焰伤害并引发爆炸，对8码内的所有敌人造成相当于该伤害50%的伤害。超过5个目标后伤害递减。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Fires an explosive shot at your target that lasts for 3 sec. Every 1 sec the target burns for (307% of Attack Power) Fire damage and explode, dealing 50% of the damage to all enemies within 8 yds. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
瞄准射击造成的伤害提高5%。

急速射击造成的伤害提高10%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Aimed Shot deals 5% increased damage.

Rapid Fire deals 10% increased damage.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 爆炸射击现在可以在施放后的3.0秒内再次使用。爆炸射击会纳入目标身上此前爆炸射击尚未造成的剩余伤害。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Explosive Shot can now be used a second time if cast within 3.0 sec. Explosive Shot will incorporate any remaining damage from previous Explosive Shots on your target.
